headline: Microsoft improves Windows 11 performance on PCs with 8GB of RAM
summary: Microsoft says it has made drastic improvements to Windows 11's performance on PCs with 8GB of RAM, targeting speed, performance and memory management so users notice gains across a wide range of apps. One outlet suggests the move comes as climbing RAM prices squeeze budgets and may be cutting into Windows revenue.
